author: mist
name: Buyer's Remorse
bootlegger: Players have 7 gold. Each day, an ability is auctioned; highest unique bidder gains it until dawn, even if dead. Bids are secret & not returned (bar evil ties).

name: Chef
ability: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.
flavor: This evening's reservations seem odd. Never before has Mrs. Mayweather kept company with that scamp from Hudson Lane. Yet, tonight, they have a table for two. Strange.

name: Noble
ability: You start knowing 3 players, 1 and only 1 of which is evil.
flavor: Sarcasm is indeed the lowest form of wit. But speaking in response to your criticism, Sir, it is, nevertheless, a form of wit.

name: Grandmother
ability: You start knowing a good player & their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.
flavor: Take a jacket if you go outside, dearie. And your thermos. And your scarf. I have a weak heart, you know. Whatever would I do if you caught cold...or worse?
firstNightReminder: Point to the grandchild player & show their character token.
otherNightReminder: If the grandchild was killed by the Demon, the Grandmother dies too. :reminder:

name: Librarian
ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)
flavor: Certainly madam, under normal circumstances, you may borrow the Codex Malificarium from the library vaults. However, you do not seem to be a member.
firstNightReminder: Show the Outsider character token. Point to both the *OUTSIDER* and *WRONG* players.

name: Chambermaid
ability: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.
flavor: I aint seen nothin' untoward, Milady. Begging your pardon, but if I did see somethin', it certainly weren't the master o' the house sneaking into the professor's laboratory 'round eleven o'clock and mixing up fancy potions, just like you said, Miss.
firstNightReminder: The Chambermaid chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.
otherNightReminder: The Chambermaid chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.

name: Monk
ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.
flavor: 'Tis an ill and deathly wind that blows tonight. Come, my brother, take shelter in the abbey while the storm rages. By my word, or by my life, you will be safe.
otherNightReminder: The Monk chooses a player. :reminder:

name: Gambler
ability: Each night*, choose a player & guess their character: if you guess wrong, you die.
flavor: Heads, I win. Tails, you lose.
otherNightReminder: The Gambler chooses a player & a character. :reminder:

name: Exorcist
ability: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then doesn't wake tonight.
flavor: We cast you out, every unclean spirit, every satanic power, every onslaught of the infernal adversary, every legion, every diabolical group and sect, in the name and by the power of Our Lord Jesus Christ. We command you, begone and fly far from the Church of God, from the souls made by God in His image and redeemed by the precious blood of the divine Lamb.
otherNightReminder: The Exorcist chooses a player. :reminder: Put the Exorcist to sleep. If the Exorcist chose the Demon: Wake the Demon. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Exorcist tokens. Point to the Exorcist.

name: Gossip
ability: Each day, you may make a public statement. Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.
flavor: Blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah blah. Blah.
otherNightReminder: If the Gossip is due to kill a player, they die. :reminder:

name: Savant
ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.
flavor: Seventy-two matchsticks on the floor... the sun sets early but the moon is unchanged... a torn piece of cloth... evil in the manor house... three by three... the one we trusted is not what he seems... green light means magnesium... residue, but the pattern is wrong... Seventy-two matchsticks on the floor...

name: Fisherman
ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller for some advice to help your team win.
flavor: This was my favourite part of the river... see how the sunlight makes a rainbow from the monastery to the market? This was the best place for big fish. And the older I get, the bigger they were.

name: Soldier
ability: You are safe from the Demon.
flavor: As David said to Goliath, as Theseus said to the Minotaur, as Arjuna said to Bhagadatta... No.

name: Cannibal
ability: You have the ability of the recently killed executee. If they are evil, you are poisoned until a good player dies by execution.
flavor: I don’t like clowns. They taste funny.

jinxes.reason: If the Cannibal gains the Butler ability, the Cannibal learns this.
If the Juggler guesses on their first day and dies by execution, tonight the living Cannibal learns how many guesses the Juggler got correct.
If the Cannibal nominated, executed, & killed the Princess today, the Demon doesn’t kill tonight.
If the Cannibal gains the Zealot ability, the Cannibal learns this.

name: Drunk
ability: You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.
flavor: I’m only a *hic* social drinker, my dear. Admittedly, I am a heavy *burp* socializer.

name: Tinker
ability: You might die at any time.
flavor: I think I see the problem. Luckily, I have an idea! This catapult will shoot twice as far with just a minor adjustment...
otherNightReminder: The Tinker might die. :reminder:

name: Sweetheart
ability: When you die, 1 player is drunk from now on.
flavor: I will never forget her. Never.
otherNightReminder: If the Sweetheart died, a player became drunk immediately. If you haven't done this yet, do so now. :reminder:

name: Mutant
ability: If you are ''mad'' about being an Outsider, you might be executed.
flavor: I am not a freak! I am a human being! Have mercy!

name: Godfather
ability: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die. [-1 or +1 Outsider]
flavor: Normally, it's just business. But when you insult my daughter, you insult me. And when you insult me, you insult my family. You really should be more careful - it would be a shame if you had an unfortunate accident.
firstNightReminder: Show the character tokens of all in-play Outsiders.
otherNightReminder: If an Outsider died today, the Godfather chooses a player. :reminder:

name: Spy
ability: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
flavor: Any brewmaster worth their liquor, knows no concoction pours trouble quicker, than one where spies seem double.
firstNightReminder: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.
otherNightReminder: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.

jinxes.reason: If the Spy is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
The Spy registers as evil to the Ogre.
If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Spy does not see the Grimoire.

name: Cerenovus
ability: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are “mad” they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.
flavor: Reality is merely an opinion. Specifically, my opinion.
firstNightReminder: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character. :reminder: Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
otherNightReminder: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character. :reminder: Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.

jinxes.reason: The Cerenovus may choose to make a player mad that they are the Goblin.

name: Assassin
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, even if for some reason they could not.
otherNightReminder: The Assassin might choose a player. :reminder: :reminder:

name: Erratanomicon
ability: Each night, the Demon may select a good character and change 1 word of their ability. If accepted, the Demon does not wake tonight. If in play, the player learns this. This may happen as many times as the number of Minions in the player count.
flavor: The Demon __ cha(nges) __ abilit_(ies) to  __ cause __the ultimate __ good team ___ defeat.
firstNightReminder: Wake the Demon. Show the *EDIT AN ABILITY?* token. The Demon might choose a character and change one word of the ability. If you accept it, nod. Put the Demon to sleep. :reminder: If in play, wake the edited player and tell them the new edit. :reminder:
otherNightReminder: Wake the Demon. Show the *EDIT AN ABILITY?* token. The Demon might choose a character and change one word of the ability. If you accept it, nod. Put the Demon to sleep. :reminder: If in play, wake the edited player and tell them the new edit. :reminder:

name: Imp
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.
flavor: We must keep our wits sharp and our sword sharper. Evil walks among us, and will stop at nothing to destroy us good, simple folk, bringing our fine town to ruin. Trust no-one. But, if you must trust someone, trust me.
otherNightReminder: The Imp chooses a player. :reminder: If the Imp chose themselves: Replace 1 alive Minion token with a spare Imp token. Put the old Imp to sleep. Wake the new Imp. Show the *YOU ARE* token, then show the Imp token.

name: Shabaloth
ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.
flavor: Blarg f'taag nm mataan! No sho gumtha m'sik na yuuu. Fluuuuuuuuurg h-sikkkh.
otherNightReminder: A previously chosen player might be resurrected. :reminder: The Shabaloth chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder:

name: Po
ability: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.
flavor: Would you like a flower? I'm so lonely.
otherNightReminder: The Po may choose a player OR chooses 3 players if they chose no-one last night. :reminder: or :reminder: :reminder: :reminder:

name: Vigormortis
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor. [-1 Outsider]
flavor: All doors are one door. All keys are one key. All cups are one cup, but whosoever drinketh of the water that I give shall never thirst, but the water shall be in him a well springing up into everlasting life.
otherNightReminder: The Vigormortis chooses a player. :reminder: If that player is a Minion, poison a neighboring Townsfolk. :reminder: :reminder:

author: Amir (Swolemate)
name: From the Depths
bootlegger: If the Demon believes to have the Puzzlemaster's ability and makes a guess, they learn arbitrary information.

name: Special Djinn
ability: Minions and Demons do not know each other. If a player publicly guesses (once per player) which players are Minion(s) and which is the Demon, their team wins.
flavor: Aw beans picked last again.

author: Urban Minotaur
name: Good Moon Rising
bootlegger: The Lleech may not choose themself as host.

author: Kenni
name: Hermit Buffet
bootlegger: During setup, all players choose 3 Outsiders and a player. If they are the Demon, the Hermit will have these 3 Outsider abilities. If they have the Drunk or Lunatic and the Ogre ability, this is the player they are choosing for the Ogre ability.
The Storyteller may ask a player to choose a different combination of Outsiders.
The Hermit learns which Outsider abilities they have unless they have the Drunk or Lunatic ability.
If Hermit has both Butler and Zealot abilities, they must vote every time their Master votes.
If the Hermit has the Butler or Zealot ability, they learn this, even if they also have the Drunk or Lunatic ability.
Upon death, all players must make a choice for the Klutz ability.
The Damsel ability cannot be combined with the Barber, Lunatic, Golem, or Zealot abilities.
The Saint ability cannot be combined with the Drunk, Mutant, or Lunatic abilities.

author: Urban Minotaur
name: Kingdom Come
bootlegger: The Vizier can only be in play if there are two or more Minions in the game.

name: Non-Verbal
ability: Communicating without real words. Gestures, noises, and pointing (and names when online) all count as non-verbal.

name: Am I Man or Muppet?
ability: If a Townsfolk is turned into a Human they are not told of the change. If a Human is turned into a Townsfolk they are not told and become the Townsfolk they believe themselves to be.

name: Bunsen Honeydew
ability: You start knowing how many characters there are in play who can create humans.

name: Rowlf the Dog
ability: You start knowing 2 players who are not townsfolk.
firstNightReminder: Point to two players who are not townsfolk

name: Pepe the Prawn
ability: You start knowing which demon is in play.

name: Sam the Eagle
ability: Each night you learn how many steps a living evil is from you. [+1 Human]
otherNightReminder: Give a finger signal

name: Kermit the Frog
ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): if they are a human they become a townsfolk.
otherNightReminder: If Kermit selected a human, remove the human reminder token. If Miss Piggy is in play instead add a human reminder token

name: Camilla the Chicken
ability: Each night*, if a player died by execution today: you learn a player of their alignment.
otherNightReminder: Show a player

name: Sweetums
ability: Each night*, you learn how many evil players voted.
otherNightReminder: Give a finger signal

name: Swedish Chef
ability: Each night*, you learn if there are more or less humans than last night. If you were non-verbal day 1, you instead learn how many humans are in play.
otherNightReminder: Give a finger signal (up, down, or number)

name: The Great Gonzo
ability: Each night*, you may choose a player: if you choose a minion they die, if you choose a townsfolk you die.
otherNightReminder: Gonzo chooses a player.

name: Rizzo the Rat
ability: Each night*, choose a player: if they are killed tonight you learn their character.
otherNightReminder: Rizzo chooses a player. Wake them again if that player dies tonight.

name: Fozzie Bear
ability: Each day, you may make a public joke. Waka waka. Tonight, you learn if it was true.
otherNightReminder: Nod if a *True* reminder was placed today.

name: Dr. Teeth
ability: If you are killed by the demon, a human becomes a townsfolk, you learn who.
otherNightReminder: If Dr. Teeth was killed by the demon tonight, remove the human reminder token from a player, show them the player.

name: Beaker
ability: If you were non-verbal day one, that night you learn the characters of players who were nonverbal (up to 4) +1 character which is not in play.

name: Long John Silver
ability: Each night*, one player who voted on you that day might die, even if you are dead.

name: Scrooge
ability: At night, if a player targets another player, they might target you instead.

name: Cameraman
ability: If you commmunicate verbally on day 1, a townsfolk might become human immediately.

name: Human
ability: You do not know you are a Human. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.
otherNightReminder: Treat them as if they were the character they think they are, but human.

name: Crazy Harry
ability: Each night choose a player, the first outsider you choose becomes evil, you learn this. [+1 outsider]
firstNightReminder: Crazy Harry selects a player. Nod the first time they select an outsider.
otherNightReminder: Crazy Harry selects a player. Nod the first time they select an outsider.

name: Scooter
ability: Once per day you may choose to take one player off the block. If just 3 players live you lose this ability.

name: Constantine
ability: Each night* choose 2 players (not the demon), they swap characters, abilities do not refresh. You register as good, and as Kermit, even if dead.
otherNightReminder: Constanine selects two players (not the demon).

name: Animal
ability: Once per game at night*, choose a player: they die, if you were nonverbal on day 1, 1 of their Townsfolk neighbours becomes human.
otherNightReminder: Does Animal want to use it? If yes, Animal chooses a player.

name: Miss Piggy
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk chosen by Kermit become humans instead. [+ Kermit]
otherNightReminder: Miss Piggy chooses a player

name: Uncle Deadly
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk who nominate you become Human.
otherNightReminder: Uncle Deadly chooses a player.

name: Statler
ability: Each night*, wake with Waldorf, together choose one player: they die.[+ Waldorf, -1 minion]
otherNightReminder: Wake with Waldorf: choose a player.

name: Waldorf
ability: Each night*, wake with Statler, together choose one player: they die.[+ Statler]
otherNightReminder: Wake with Statler: choose a player.

author: Brockwell
name: Nobody Fucking Move
bootlegger: Optional rule: The Alchemist has a not-in-play Minion ability.

author: Urban Minotaur
name: Oops! All Outsiders
bootlegger: Any character that CAN add Outsiders in setup DOES add Outsiders in setup.

name: Opium Den
author: Corey and Bell
bootlegger: The Poppy Grower is Stormcaught and thinks they are a different out of play Townsfolk or Outsider. They are not.

name: Poppy Grower
ability: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, they learn who each other are that night.
flavor: In the hidden groves of the deep forest, the black poppy dwells. To see its revelry is to be enchanted. To smell its thick aroma is to be lost forever, a slave to the gods of light and dark.
firstNightReminder: Do not do the Minion Info and Demon Info steps. Wake the Demon, show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* info token and any three good character tokens that are not in play.
otherNightReminder: If the Poppy Grower died today or tonight, wake the Minions, show the *THIS IS THE DEMON* info token and point to the Demon. Put them to sleep. Wake the Demon, show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* info token and point to the Minions. Put the Demon to sleep.

author: Broom
name: Replication Error
bootlegger: If more than one Mutant is executed from being "mad" about being an Outsider, good loses.

name: Mutant
ability: If you are "Mad" about being an Outsider, you might be executed.
flavor: I am not a freak! I am a human being! Have mercy!

jinxes.reason: The Cerenovus cannot make people "Mad" as the Mutant.

name: Sushi Buffet
author: Grimbits.com
bootlegger: This script is designed for the Sushi Buffet draft. Each player spins the wheel and picks from 3 random characters. Outsider count may be adjusted dynamically based on characters in play. You may be asked to redraft if the Storyteller decides. Unchosen characters are recycled back into the draft pool — later players may see characters that earlier players rejected.
Ivory draft: at most one alignment-changing character may be drafted (Lord of Typhon, Mezepheles, Fang Gu, Bounty Hunter, Goon, Cult Leader, Legion, Politician, Ogre, Philosopher, Pit-Hag).
If Choirboy is drafted, King is automatically added to the game.
If Huntsman is drafted, Damsel is automatically added to the game.
Players may mulligan — reject all choices to get fewer new ones. First mulligan gives 2 choices, second gives 1.
One player may be shown a character they don't actually have. They could be the Drunk, Marionette or Lunatic and not know it.
Banned Characters: Philosopher, Engineer, Hatter, Pit Hag, Atheist, Heretic, Legion, Amnesiac, Wizard, Politician, Spy

author: DrC
name: The Autopsy
bootlegger: Gossip kills can also happen during the ongoing day.

name: Forensics
ability: Each night*, choose a player. If they are dead, you learn their cause of death.
flavor: Post-mortem analysis of the protofrontal lymbic system suggests the victim died of a brain arrest due to excessive mediocre gambling.
otherNightReminder: The Forensics choose a player. If that player is dead, show them either the character responsible for their death, or just the word 'DEMON'

name: Shinobi
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player. They are marked for death, and can die at any time.
flavor: Omae wa mou… shinde iru. – NANI ?!
otherNightReminder: Wake the Shinobi. Ask if they want to use their ability. If they say yes, ask them to pick a player. Mark that player with the :MARKED: token

name: Nemesis
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If a Minion died today, you act twice tonight.
flavor: An eye for an eye, an heart for an heart…
otherNightReminder: Wake Nemesis. If the :ACTS TWICE: token is on them, tell them to pick two players. Otherwise, tell them to pick one.

author: Urban Minotaur
name: Veiled Threats
bootlegger: The Fortune Teller gets a 0, 1, or 2 depending on the number of players they picked that register as the demon.
Players who choose a player their character would not ordinarily be able to choose, such as an Exorcist choosing the same person twice in a row, are drunk for that night.
